title: Night Wraith: '65 Cadillac Convertible
subtitle: Slammed Air Ride & Comfort Cruiser
summary: A 1965 Cadillac Convertible custom cruiser engineered with a custom bagged air suspension setup to lay frame while effortlessly clearing speed bumps, featuring additional short rear-hinged suicide doors on each side.

specifications.suspension: Custom Full-Range Air Ride (Lays frame & negotiates speed bumps)
specifications.doors: Re-Engineered Custom Short Rear Suicide Doors

narrative: Night Wraith captures the essence of classic South Bay boulevard cruising in a 1965 Cadillac Convertible silhouette.
Built strictly for comfort, presence, and smooth street performance, the body features re-engineered short suicide doors added behind the front doors on each side for refined passenger ingress.

The custom air ride chassis is engineered for full travel flexibility—allowing the massive land yacht to lay complete frame at park while lifting on command to clear steep driveways and speed bumps with ease.
